reviews.author: Natalia Boj
reviews.quote: Para los agentes, supone ahorrar tiempo, mejorar seguimiento y trabajar de una forma mucho más profesional y moderna.
reviews.text:
PropertyList está evolucionando muy bien y se nota que están apostando fuerte por la innovación dentro del sector inmobiliario. Como agente, valoro especialmente que no se hayan quedado en un simple CRM o MLS tradicional, sino que estén incorporando mejoras enfocadas en automatización, productividad y experiencia del cliente.

La incorporación de asistentes inteligentes y herramientas más orientadas a agilizar la gestión comercial es exactamente hacia donde va el mercado inmobiliario actual. Hoy en día, responder rápido, organizar leads y ofrecer una atención más eficiente marca una gran diferencia, y se nota que PropertyList está trabajando en esa dirección.

Para los agentes, supone ahorrar tiempo, mejorar seguimiento y trabajar de una forma mucho más profesional y moderna. Y para los clientes, la experiencia es más fluida, rápida y organizada.

Me gusta ver plataformas inmobiliarias que entienden que la inteligencia artificial y la automatización no son el futuro, sino el presente del sector. Muy buena evolución y muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Paola Hormigo
reviews.text:
As an estate agent working on the Costa del Sol, finding a platform that genuinely supports agencies, rather than just charging for visibility, has been a challenge. PropertyList has been a refreshing change.

The platform is clearly built with agents in mind. The ability to publish listings quickly, gain international exposure, and manage enquiries efficiently has saved our team significant time. We've also noticed that the leads tend to be more serious and better qualified compared to traditional portals.

One of the biggest advantages is the cost structure. Unlike other portals that charge heavily for basic visibility, PropertyList provides essential tools and exposure without excessive monthly fees, allowing us to invest more into marketing and client service.

The support and ongoing improvements also stand out. It feels like a platform that is evolving alongside the needs of modern real estate agencies.

Overall, PropertyList has become an important part of our marketing strategy and a valuable channel for reaching international buyers.

reviews.author: Alain fiddelers
reviews.text:
As a real estate professional, I can honestly say that PropertyList is a fantastic program. It provides everything you need in one place, from organization and management to marketing and follow-up. The platform is incredibly user-friendly, intuitive, and designed with the daily reality of real estate agents in mind.

What I appreciate most is how complete and efficient it is. It saves time, keeps processes structured, and helps you operate at a higher professional level. PropertyList is not just a tool, it's a serious asset for anyone who wants to grow their business in the real estate world.

I truly value working with a system like this, and I highly recommend it to any ambitious real estate professional looking to scale and streamline their business!

reviews.author: Frances Evans
reviews.text:
I've just joined PropertyList.es and I'm extremely impressed.

Unlike other platforms, PropertyList.es only allows verified Estate Agents to list properties. This protects listings and prevents third parties from uploading properties directly - a huge plus for agents.

It's a well thought out MLS, CRM and property portal all in one: streamlined, professional, and clearly designed with the agent's interests in mind.

A fantastic platform for agents who value collaboration, transparency, and protecting their stock.

By Frances Concierge
@byfrances.concierge

reviews.author: Leila Georg
reviews.quote: I've actually found Buyers through other agents for important listings that i had to sell for my owners through it.
reviews.text:
PropertyList CRM has been a great tool for me as an agent. It's completely free to join, easy to use, and has all the features I need without feeling complicated. One of the best parts is the property push feature - you can use your credits to boost your listings, and I've actually found Buyers through other agents for important listings that i had to sell for my owners through it.
I recomend it to all agents on teh costa del sol , who have listings but do not want to pay for many platfroms.
The crm also comes with facebook groups, whatsapp groups that are very helpful and organizaed for us agents to use.

I highly recomend to join !!

My kindest regards,

Leila
Marpro Group Agency
